info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Education Enrollments Materials-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Materials API provides access to a comprehensive list of materials associated with educational enrollments. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about various educational resources and materials available for enrolled students. Typical consumers include educators, administrators, and IT personnel looking to facilitate access to learning materials. Use this endpoint to streamline resource management and enhance the educational experience for students.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of materials related to enrollments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all materials associated with enrollments, providing detailed information to help users understand available resources.
